about.title: About the Expo
about.description: Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo 2026 is the first international horticultural expo in Northeastern Thailand. Located at Nong Dae Wetland, Kut Sa Subdistrict, Mueang District, Udon Thani Province, the expo blends nature, art, and innovation to create an unforgettable experience for visitors from around the world.
about.locationValue: Nong Dae Wetland, Kut Sa Subdistrict, Mueang District, Udon Thani
about.organizerValue: Udon Thani Province & Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives
highlights.title: Event Highlights
highlights.gardensDesc: Explore international botanical gardens from over 50 countries, blending local culture with world-class design.
highlights.internationalDesc: Discover unique pavilions from around the world showcasing horticulture and cultural heritage.
highlights.activitiesDesc: Join interactive activities such as tree planting, terrarium making, and garden design workshops.
highlights.foodDesc: Savor authentic Isan cuisine and international dishes from top vendors across the country.
highlights.cultureDesc: Enjoy Isan cultural performances, theater shows, and live music throughout the expo.
highlights.innovationDesc: Discover cutting-edge agricultural and environmental technology and innovations.

visitor.title: Visitor Information
visitor.ticketsDesc: Adult 200 THB / Child 100 THB / Students Free (with ID)
visitor.transportDesc: Public buses from Udon Thani city, vans, songthaews, and free shuttle bus from the train station.
visitor.parkingDesc: Spacious parking for over 5,000 vehicles with disability parking available.
visitor.facilitiesDesc: Tourist information center, medical room, restaurants, ATMs, charging stations, free Wi-Fi.
